text: {"standards":[{"code":"W.6.3","verdict":"taught","reason":"In Part A, students plan a story with a setting, characters, and four sequenced events, and in Part B they draft an opening using setting, dialogue, description, and transition words."},{"code":"W.6.4","verdict":"partly","reason":"The Literacy Lab revision of noun phrases and pronoun reference supports clarity, but no Activity has students consider task, purpose, or audience for their writing."},{"code":"RL.6.9","verdict":"partly","reason":"The Launch Turn and Talk and the Part A Pulse Check compare Riordan's gods with the myth's patterns, but students never compare texts across different forms or genres in terms of their approaches to a shared theme."}],"anchorText":{"verdict":"uses","reason":"The Launch and Part A activities direct students to pp. 224–233 and Chapter 15 of The Lightning Thief, which matches the text the Outline names."}}
